acceptance_boundaries.meaning: The existing integration cases and registry are source evidence only in this review. No local PostgreSQL was run, and this report does not assert that current-head private before/after restart groups passed.
Schemas and readiness contracts exist, but applying migrations, provisioning databases/files, service rollout and backfill are operator work and were explicitly excluded as migration/deployment work.

FCM delivery, federation peers, OAuth consent UI/upstream account providers, call/livestream transports, geocoder/translation/reader endpoints, remote media origins and similar integrations require real operator configuration, allowlists, credentials and reachable services. Their absence in this workspace is not missing implementation code; unconfigured paths fail closed or expose explicit unavailable behavior.

Physical NFC/PCSC tags/readers and configured ffmpeg/helper/limiter executables were not exercised. The adapters, validation and explicit configuration paths are present; actual device/tool acceptance remains external.

Federation custody keys, media roots/pools, Rewind dictionary files and hashes, treasury wallets/funding, PIN/issuer/push secrets and policy snapshots must be provisioned explicitly. The code does not invent production credentials, keys, dictionaries, hardware or funds.

acceptance_boundaries.boundary: external client repository and end-to-end acceptance
acceptance_boundaries.meaning: This is not a scope exclusion. The current repository retains the required client-facing HTTP/JSON contracts, producer payloads and notification stable-key bridge. Separate client repositories were not provided, so packaging/release and live end-to-end execution of those external clients cannot be verified here; no in-repository feature was treated as optional on that basis.

No claim is made for Apple Store, Paddle, Afdian or another external payment-provider channel, data migration/backfill, or legacy/version compatibility. Internal wallet, funds, settlement, subscription, reporting, payment-PIN and SourcePoints behavior remains included and is mapped above.

non_claims: external client repositories released or end-to-end verified

client_contract_closure.statement: No in-repository client-facing API, JSON contract, producer payload or required push stable-key bridge was skipped as client adaptation. Each mapped client-accessible business family is exposed through its ports handler and internal/application/router.go host composition. External client repositories were not supplied, so their release and end-to-end execution remain an acceptance limit rather than a scope exclusion.
